title: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets
summary: Prescribes the recognition, measurement and disclosure of provisions, contingent liabilities and contingent assets, including the present-value measurement, reimbursements, restructuring and onerous-contract treatment. Effective 1 January 2004.
description: IPSAS 19 Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets prescribes the recognition, measurement and disclosure of provisions, contingent liabilities and contingent assets.
